offer.text: A table massage using long, controlled strokes and medium pressure, with pressure and pace adjusted to the client during the session. The business describes it as a relaxation-focused option that can help ease everyday tension and settle the nervous system. Unscented, hypoallergenic oils are used by default, with aromatherapy available on request. Clients are professionally draped throughout, with only the area being worked uncovered. You can ask for lighter or firmer pressure, and the therapist checks in and adjusts. Sessions take place in a private studio room; the 60-, 90-, and 120-minute rate options are published in the studio's service guide.
